name: Fishar
summary: A fishing social network for Android and iOS. Pin spots on the map, share your catches and follow other anglers.
description: A social network for anglers: pin your spots on the map, share what you caught and find out where the community is fishing.

architecture.presentation: Widgets without business logic; state lives in the cubit.
architecture.domain: Pure Dart, no Flutter or Firebase: tests run in milliseconds.
architecture.data: Implements the domain contract; switching backends does not touch the UI.
